#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <ext/numeric>
using namespace std;
using namespace __gnu_cxx;

const double EPS = 1e-15;

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
	freopen("in.txt", "rt", stdin);
#endif
	int x, y, n;
	scanf("%d%d%d", &x, &y, &n);
	long long best_num = 0, best_den = 1;
	double min_error = numeric_limits<double>::max();
	
	for (long long denom = 1; denom <= n; ++denom) {
		long long num1 = (denom * x) / y;
		long long num2 = (denom * x + y - 1) / y;
		
		double err1 = abs(static_cast<double>(num1) / denom - static_cast<double>(x) / y);
		double err2 = abs(static_cast<double>(num2) / denom - static_cast<double>(x) / y);
		
		if (err1 < min_error - EPS) {
			min_error = err1;
			best_num = num1;
			best_den = denom;
		}
		if (err2 < min_error - EPS) {
			min_error = err2;
			best_num = num2;
			best_den = denom;
		}
	}
	
	printf("%lld/%lld", best_num, best_den);
	return 0;
}
